name: Ricardo Vargas Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo's fascination with electronics began in his youth, tinkering with radios and appliances in his family's workshop in Lima. This passion led him to pursue a degree in electrical engineering, specializing in embedded systems and control. His introduction to motorsport came during a university project where he helped design a telemetry system for a local rally team. The thrill of real-time data analysis and performance optimization hooked him instantly.

After graduation, Ricardo gained experience in various engineering roles before landing a position with Dick Johnson Racing. He believes in a meticulous, data-driven approach to problem-solving, constantly seeking ways to improve the car's performance through innovative electronic solutions. He’s known for his ability to quickly diagnose complex electrical issues and his unwavering commitment to precision.
